question: The lesion at the level of the posterior roots of the spinal cord produces:

options.opa: Affectation of all forms of sensitivity in metameric and ipsilateral distribution.
options.opb: Homolateral involvement of all forms of sensitivity below the point of injury.
options.opc: Thermoanalgesia of metameric and bilateral distribution.
options.opd: Thermoanalgesia below the lesion and contralateral.
options.ope: Deep anesthesia below the lesion and contralateral.
